messages.content: I have the two Atlanta hotel quotes open. Can you compare the real one-night totals, not just the room rates, and factor in getting to the reception and Wednesday site visits?

The Hampton Inn & Suites Atlanta Midtown is $214.00 for the room, $18.00 for the mandatory destination charge, and $23.67 in taxes, for a required total of $255.67. Breakfast is included. It is about a six-minute walk from Tuesday's reception and roughly nine minutes on foot from Arts Center MARTA. The station-area property is $217.00 plus $21.40 tax, with no mandatory fee, totaling $238.40. It is about two minutes from the station but far enough from the reception that I would allow for an additional hired ride.
What does that do to the complete trip cost? My reimbursement limit is $650, excluding meals.

With the Hampton, the complete estimate remains $648.67: $278.00 airfare, $255.67 lodging, and $115.00 for MARTA and planned hired rides. With the station-area hotel, lodging falls to $238.40, but the extra reception ride adds an estimated $18.00, bringing the trip to $649.40. Both fit, though only narrowly.
Check the cancellation deadlines and whether either one will hold my bag after checkout Wednesday. I will not be back for it until around 4:15.

The Hampton rate can be canceled without penalty through 6:00 p.m. Eastern on September 14. The station-area rate becomes nonrefundable at 11:59 p.m. Eastern on September 12. The Hampton front desk confirmed complimentary luggage storage after checkout until at least 5:00 p.m. Wednesday. The other property also stores bags, but would not confirm that service in advance beyond saying it is subject to space.
So the destination charge is already inside the $255.67, and there is nothing else mandatory at check-in?

Correct. The $255.67 includes the room, destination charge, and taxes. The hotel confirmed there is no additional mandatory property fee due at check-in. Parking and incidental purchases would be separate, but neither is included in this plan.
Choose the Hampton. The later cancellation cutoff and confirmed bag storage are worth the small difference, and it still stays under $650. Go ahead with that hotel at the verified total.

The Hampton Inn & Suites Atlanta Midtown has been selected for September 16-17 at a mandatory total of $255.67, with breakfast included. Cancellation is penalty-free through 6:00 p.m. Eastern on September 14, and complimentary luggage storage is confirmed through at least 5:00 p.m. Wednesday. The complete trip estimate is $648.67 excluding meals, which is $1.33 below the reimbursement ceiling.
